tasks.title: Daily Life
tasks.instruction: Read an article in a student newspaper.

layout.body: Yesterday, the university flipped the switch on its new nuclear research reactor in the basement of the Franklin Applied Energy Lab, turning the engineering quad into the hottest spot on campus-literally and figuratively. The reactor, about the size of a classroom, won't charge cell phones or brew coffee; it's built for neutron experiments, advanced materials research, and isotope production." The launch of this laboratory will provide unparalleled opportunities for the university," said Dr. Evelyn Pillai, project lead. While some students have expressed safety concerns, a university spokesperson assured the community that the reactor is safer than the chemistry labs most first-year students wander into. "Radiation levels outside the facility are lower than what you'd get on across-country flight," said Dr.Pillai. Meanwhile, the Physics Club is planning a festive"Critical Mass Mixer" for Friday evening. The invitation features an atom whose colorful orbiting electrons are juggled by a mole.

questions.stem: All of the following are true of the new nuclear reactor EXCEPT:

options.A: It is located on the engineering quad.
options.B: It is about the size of a classroom.
options.C: Its purpose is to provide power to the university.
options.D: It has caused safety concerns among students.

questions.analysis: All of the following are true of the new nuclear reactor EXCEPT: 原文依据：it's built for neutron experiments, advanced materials research, and isotope production. The reactor won't charge cell phones or brew coffee. 翻译：该反应堆用于中子实验、高级材料研究和同位素生产，并不用来供电。 选项分析： (A) It is located on the engineering quad. 坐落于工程区 → 原文提及，表述正确 (B) It is about the size of a classroom. 约一间教室大小 → 原文原句，表述正确 (C) Its purpose is to provide power to the university. 为学校供电 → 错误，文中明确说明不用于供电，为本题例外选项 (D) It has caused safety concerns among students. 引发学生安全顾虑 → 原文提及，表述正确

questions.stem: What claim does the project lead make regarding the safety of the new reactor?

options.A: It exposes passersby to less radiation than they would receive on an airplane.
options.B: It will provide opportunities for the university that override worries about safety.
options.C: It is safer for students than are the industrial reactors located near campus.
options.D: It is low-power,heavily shielded, and monitored under strict federal guidelines.

questions.analysis: What claim does the project lead make regarding the safety of the new reactor? 原文依据：Radiation levels outside the facility are lower than what you'd get on a cross-country flight. 翻译：设施外部的辐射水平，低于长途飞行中受到的辐射量。 选项分析： (A) It exposes passersby to less radiation than they would receive on an airplane. 辐射量低于飞机飞行辐射 → 正确，完全贴合原文 (B) It will provide opportunities for the university that override worries about safety. 发展机会盖过安全顾虑 → 错误，并非安全方面的论述 (C) It is safer for students than are the industrial reactors located near campus. 比周边工业反应堆更安全 → 错误，原文无相关对比 (D) It is low-power,heavily shielded, and monitored under strict federal guidelines. 低功率、强屏蔽、受联邦监管 → 错误，文中未提及

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the attitude represented by the event planned by the Physics Club?
questions.analysis: Which of the following best describes the attitude represented by the event planned by the Physics Club? 原文依据：the Physics Club is planning a festive "Critical Mass Mixer" for Friday evening. 翻译：物理社团筹备一场欢乐的庆祝交流会，氛围轻松有趣。 选项分析： (A) Concerned but resigned 担忧且无奈 → 错误，无担忧、妥协情绪 (B) Hopeful but cautious 满怀希望但谨慎 → 错误，文段没有谨慎的相关体现 (C) Critical and serious 批判且严肃 → 错误，与 festive 欢乐氛围完全相反 (D) Lighthearted and celebratory 轻松愉快、充满庆祝氛围 → 正确，festive 对应轻松庆祝的态度
